scope: Same-host counterbalanced CNN3 FC5-shaped 100x64x10 q128/bw32 n8192,c2,t8 SCI/IKNP experiment; one warmup plus ten measured invocations per version; parties on GPUs1/2, post-exit checker on GPU3; no security-pinned, dealerless-baseline, full-model, or distinct-host claim. Process latency uses blocking waitpid under external GNU timeout, not timed polling; excludes checker.

paired_process_speedup.method: Descriptive paired nonparametric bootstrap: 10000 resamples of the ten trial pairs with replacement, median before/after process-latency ratio, seed 20260910, nearest-rank percentiles. This does not establish generality or eliminate shared-host interference.

source_commits.binding: These source-only export commits were created after measurement. The exported before/after OT headers match the retained before/after headers byte for byte; sample binary SHA256s are recorded. This is not a pre-measurement commit pin, clean-clone release attestation, or claim that all historical artifacts match these commits.

method_limits: Shared host; GPU0 had unrelated activity and was not used or modified.
Idle-memory/utilization admission and post-run snapshots on GPUs1/2/3, not exclusive GPU leases or fixed power/clock settings.
Fixed shape, cryptographically unpinned feasibility parameters, SCI/IKNP only, same-host loopback.
Five before-after and five after-before measured pairs; one warmup per version; all final invocations retained.
An earlier pilot used timeout-polling wait and is excluded as an instrumentation experiment, not an outlier exclusion. Final controller timer uses blocking wait under GNU timeout.
Application-ready preprocessing was checked only after both parties exited; online inference and checker time are excluded from the process-latency timer.
regeneration: Group samples by side and trial; keep sample_role==measured; process median is median(controller_launch_to_party_exit_us); post-channel setup-included is median(max_p(total_us+preflight_us+ot_setup_us)); Phase B is median(max_p(dpf_phase_b_us)). Do not count the two party rows as independent samples.

command_contract.private_state: New owner-only work root, random invocation and 32-byte channel authentication secret, and new party-local ledger/output per trial; no correlation reuse.
command_contract.process_timeout: timeout --kill-after=5 180 <producer arguments>; blocking child.wait() in parent.
command_contract.checker: <same per-version producer binary> --check --csv-header --p0-record <fresh-p0/key_p0.fc> --p1-record <fresh-p1/key_p1.fc>, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3, after both producer processes exited.
command_contract.producer_common: --host 127.0.0.1 --port <21800+4*trial> --sid <fresh positive 62-bit value> --invocation-id <fresh 128-bit hex> --ledger <fresh owner-only ledger> --qbits 128 --bw 32 --rows 100 --inner 64 --cols 10 --ole-n 8192 --ole-c 2 --ole-t 8 --noise regular --csv-header
command_contract.producer_party: --party <0|1> --out-prefix <fresh-party-directory>/key --channel-auth-file <fresh-party-directory>/auth; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<1|2>; both processes launched before blocking waits.
command_contract.checker_sha256: Matches the per-version producer binary SHA256, because --check dispatches its independent stock-consumer validation path.
